author: mlynn
name: Election results
description: Who's leading the 2026 House, Senate or Governor races, from official state counts: the tally, the races to watch, or one race in full
title: {{ settings.race ? (settings.race | upper | trim) + ' ' + data.e.office : data.e.office + ' ' + data.e.year + ' · leading, not called' }}

settings.label: One race in full (e.g. TX or TX-07; blank for all)

children.text: {{ data.e.counts.races - (data.e.races | entries | where:'value.leader':'D' | count) - (data.e.races | entries | where:'value.leader':'R' | count) }} other
children.when: data.e.counts.races > (data.e.races | entries | where:'value.leader':'D' | count) + (data.e.races | entries | where:'value.leader':'R' | count)

children.flex: {{ data.e.counts.races - (data.e.races | entries | where:'value.leader':'D' | count) - (data.e.races | entries | where:'value.leader':'R' | count) }}
children.when: data.e.counts.races > (data.e.races | entries | where:'value.leader':'D' | count) + (data.e.races | entries | where:'value.leader':'R' | count)

children.text: {{ data.e.counts.races }} races in {{ data.e.races | entries | count }} with results · {{ data.e.counts.reporting }} fully counted, {{ data.e.counts.races - data.e.counts.reporting }} still counting
{{ settings.view == 'counting' ? 'Still counting · least counted first' : settings.view == 'all' ? 'Every race' : 'Closest · gap between the top two' }}

children.items: settings.view == 'counting' ? (data.e.races | entries | where:'value.total') : (data.e.races | entries | where:'value.total' | where:'value.uncontested':false)
children.sortBy: settings.view == 'counting' ? (r.value.pct_in >= 100 ? null : r.value.pct_in) : settings.view == 'all' ? null : r.value.cands[0].pct - r.value.cands[1].pct

children.text: {{ data.e.races[settings.race | upper | trim] ? ((data.e.races[settings.race | upper | trim].total | number:0) + ' votes · ' + (data.e.races[settings.race | upper | trim].pct_in >= 100 ? 'fully counted' : (data.e.races[settings.race | upper | trim].pct_in | int) + '% counted') + ' · lead ' + ((data.e.races[settings.race | upper | trim].cands[0].v - data.e.races[settings.race | upper | trim].cands[1].v) | number:0) + ' votes') : 'No ' + data.e.office + ' race "' + (settings.race | upper | trim) + '" in this feed' }}
